the-marker-is-hidden._: The deliverable itself, invisible. Satisfies decision 88 on paper and fails it entirely in practice — the office would be none the wiser that we are missing a document, which is the one thing the marker exists to say. Must kill the names-BOTH test, and ONLY because the assertion is toBeVisible rather than toContainText.

the-marker-makes-a-finding-about-the-off._: The realistic regression: somebody adds a non-compliance finding to the marker to be helpful. Decision 88 rule 4 forbids it — an office licensed by the Central Bank already submitted these to the regulator, so our holding no record is OUR gap, not its violation. Anchored on a SHORT fragment: the first version anchored on the whole scope sentence and expired the moment that sentence was corrected for a separate reason.
the-marker-makes-a-finding-about-the-off.from: not a judgement about the office
the-marker-makes-a-finding-about-the-off.to: a finding that the office is non-compliant with art. 10/a

the-marker-always-names-both._: Ignore what we actually hold and list both documents every time. The office then chases a document we already have. Anchored on a SHORT distinctive fragment rather than the whole call: the first version spanned three lines and expired the moment prettier reflowed the chain.

absence-blocks-the-save._: Decision 88's FIRST rule, inverted: a missing art. 10/a document refuses the registration. An office the Central Bank has already licensed then cannot be recorded until WE hold our own copy. Must kill 'the save SUCCEEDS'.

the-complete-marker-overclaims._: Restore the overclaim: say the documents are HELD when this product has no object storage and `storageRef` names a location nothing can fetch. The MISSING side's wording is the dictionary's verbatim (v4 broker sheet field 48) and is untouched; only the complete side was mine. Must kill 'both uploaded: NO marker at all', which is where the honest claim is pinned.
the-complete-marker-overclaims.from: 'The registration pack is complete: both documents are recorded in the system — the file name, where it is filed, and who filed it.'
the-complete-marker-overclaims.to: 'The registration pack is complete: both documents are held in the system.'
